title: Caustic: hallucination detection and repair for language models from the orbit partition of a relation
description: A model can know a fact and still be unable to reach it. When it cannot, distinct entities collapse onto one answer. Caustic treats that collapse as a topological invariant of the orbit partition of a relation: it is measurable with no ground truth and bounded from below by a theorem. The same bound then selects the intervention, including the noise level to add and whether to intervene at all. Reported 0.995 AUROC with no ground truth, behind five proved bounds.
